title: Hand in HORIZON KIOSK, PDFs and EVIDENCE

questions.label: 1a
questions.question_text: Change the slide size to 16:10. Take a screenshot of the Slide Size window and paste it into EVIDENCE at 1a.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Slide size 16:10 shown in the screenshot.
Check / do not accept: Screenshot must be readable. 16:9 not accepted.

questions.label: 1b
questions.question_text: Set the background to the BACKGROUND image at 50% transparency.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: BACKGROUND image on all slides at 50% transparency.
Check / do not accept: Accept 45–55%. Image applied slide by slide but at 50% on every slide: accept.

questions.label: 1c
questions.question_text: Set the title text colour to dark green so that it has high contrast with the background.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Dark green title text with high contrast against the background.
Check / do not accept: Black or light green not accepted.

questions.label: 1d
questions.question_text: Make all slide titles italic and underlined.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: All titles italic and underlined.
Check / do not accept: Must be on every slide title.

questions.label: 1e
questions.question_text: Insert the LOGO in the top right corner so that it appears on every slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: LOGO top right on every slide.
Check / do not accept: Logo copied onto each slide in the same place: accept.

questions.label: 1f
questions.question_text: Add the footer text Horizon Science Museum – Visitor Kiosk in the centre of the footer, and a date that updates automatically.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Footer text Horizon Science Museum – Visitor Kiosk centred, and an automatically updating date.
Check / do not accept: Both needed. A fixed typed date not accepted.

questions.label: 1g
questions.question_text: Add a slide number on the right. Do not show the footer or slide number on the title slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Slide number on the right, and no footer or slide number on slide 1.
Check / do not accept: Both needed.

questions.label: 1h
questions.question_text: Hide the date placeholder on the Two Content layout master.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: No date on slides 3 and 6 (Two Content), date shown on slides 2, 4 and 5.
Check / do not accept: Date deleted from individual slides instead of the layout master: do not accept if the screenshot shows it is still on the layout.

questions.label: 1i
questions.question_text: Add a picture placeholder to the Title Only layout master.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Picture placeholder on the Title Only layout (slide 2 image sits in a picture placeholder).
Check / do not accept: Image inserted with Insert > Pictures on slide 2 only: not accepted.

questions.label: 1j
questions.question_text: Take a screenshot of Slide Master view that shows the slide master and the layout masters. Paste it into EVIDENCE at 1j. Close Slide Master view before you add any content.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Screenshot of Slide Master view showing the slide master and the layout masters, with house style applied; no slide content added to the master.
Check / do not accept: Normal view screenshot not accepted.

questions.label: 2a
questions.question_text: Add every slide using New Slide and the layout shown in the table, so that every slide uses the master slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: All six slides use the stated layouts and the master (background, logo, footer appear on every slide).
Check / do not accept: Blank slides with drawn text boxes not accepted.

questions.label: 2b
questions.question_text: Select text from HORIZON TEXT and enter it into the placeholders as short bullet points. Do not paste whole paragraphs.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Text selected from HORIZON TEXT as short bullet points on slides 3 and 4.
Check / do not accept: Whole paragraphs pasted, or café/history text included: not accepted.

questions.label: 2c
questions.question_text: Insert the images into the placeholders. Every image must be relevant to the museum.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Images in placeholders: ROBOT (slide 3), MICROSCOPE (slide 6) and a relevant image on slide 2.
Check / do not accept: PIZZA used anywhere: no mark.

questions.label: 2d
questions.question_text: The directions in HORIZON TEXT are too long for a slide. On slide 5, replace the directions with the MAP image so that the slide gives the same information with less reading.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Slide 5 shows the MAP image instead of the directions paragraph.
Check / do not accept: A short caption is fine. Directions paragraph still present: not accepted.

questions.label: 2e
questions.question_text: Resize the ROBOT image on slide 3 and the MICROSCOPE image on slide 6 to exactly 8 cm wide and 6 cm high.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: ROBOT and MICROSCOPE both 8 cm × 6 cm.
Check / do not accept: Check Picture Format > Size in the file. Accept ±0.1 cm.

questions.label: 2f
questions.question_text: Make sure your slides are fit for purpose for visitors: easy to read, with no text or images overlapping and no stretched images.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Fit for purpose: readable font size, clear hierarchy, nothing overlapping or cut off, no distorted images.
Check / do not accept: Holistic judgement across all slides.

questions.label: 3a
questions.question_text: On slide 3, apply the same entrance effect to each gallery name only. Do not animate the title, the image or the logo.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: The same entrance effect on each of the three gallery names on slide 3, and nothing else animated.
Check / do not accept: Title, image or logo animated: no mark. Different effects: no mark.

questions.label: 3b
questions.question_text: Use the Animation Pane so that the gallery names appear one after another, each starting After Previous.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Animation Pane order matches the list, each starting After Previous.
Check / do not accept: On Click or With Previous not accepted.

questions.label: 3c
questions.question_text: Set the duration of each gallery name animation to 2.5 seconds.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Duration 2.5 seconds on each gallery name animation.
Check / do not accept: Delay of 2.5 s instead of duration: not accepted.

questions.label: 3d
questions.question_text: On slide 1, add a transition that moves to slide 2 automatically after 3 seconds, not on mouse click.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Slide 1 transition: After 00:03.00 ticked and On Mouse Click unticked.
Check / do not accept: Both settings needed.

questions.label: 3e
questions.question_text: Take a screenshot of the Animation Pane for slide 3 and a screenshot of the Transitions tab for slide 1. Paste them into EVIDENCE at 3e.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Both screenshots present and readable (Animation Pane for slide 3, Transitions tab for slide 1).
Check / do not accept: Both needed.

questions.label: 4a
questions.question_text: On slide 2, add a hyperlink from the text Our Galleries to slide 3.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Our Galleries on slide 2 links to slide 3.
Check / do not accept: Test in Slide Show view.

questions.label: 4b
questions.question_text: Add hyperlinks from the other three menu items to slides 4, 5 and 6, so that every menu item works.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: The other three menu items link to slides 4, 5 and 6.
Check / do not accept: All three must work.

questions.label: 4c
questions.question_text: On slides 3, 4, 5 and 6, add a Home action button that links to slide 2 (Menu). The button must be in the same position on every slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Home action button on slides 3–6, linked to slide 2, in the same position on every slide.
Check / do not accept: Linked to Next Slide or First Slide: not accepted. Text hyperlink instead of an action button: not accepted.

questions.label: 4d
questions.question_text: Take a screenshot of the Action Settings window for the Home action button. Paste it into EVIDENCE at 4d.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Screenshot of Action Settings showing Hyperlink to: slide 2 (Menu).
Check / do not accept: Must be readable.

questions.label: 4e
questions.question_text: On slide 6, add a hyperlink to the website http://www.horizonmuseum.service and a hyperlink to the email address info@horizonmuseum.service
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Website link http://www.horizonmuseum.service and email link mailto:info@horizonmuseum.service on slide 6.
Check / do not accept: Both needed. Check spelling.

questions.label: 4f
questions.question_text: On slide 4, add a hyperlink from the text See all ticket prices to the file TICKET PRICES.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: See all ticket prices on slide 4 links to the TICKET PRICES file.
Check / do not accept: Link to a web address not accepted.

questions.label: 5a
questions.question_text: Add the speaker notes from HORIZON TEXT to slide 5.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Speaker notes from HORIZON TEXT on slide 5.
Check / do not accept: Check NOTES PDF or the file.

questions.label: 5b
questions.question_text: Enter your name and class in the Notes and Handouts footer.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Name and class in the Notes and Handouts footer, visible on HANDOUTS or NOTES.
Check / do not accept: Typed on the slide footer instead: not accepted.

questions.label: 5c
questions.question_text: Print all slides as handouts with 6 slides per page. Print to PDF and name the file HANDOUTS.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: HANDOUTS PDF: 6 slides per page, all six slides (1 page).
Check / do not accept: Other layouts not accepted.

questions.label: 5d
questions.question_text: Print the notes page for slide 5 only. Print to PDF and name the file NOTES.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: NOTES PDF: notes page for slide 5 showing the slide and its notes.
Check / do not accept: Notes page for a different slide not accepted.

questions.label: 5e
questions.question_text: Print slide 2 as a full page slide. Print to PDF and name the file FULL PAGE.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: FULL PAGE PDF: slide 2 as one full page slide.

questions.label: S1
questions.question_text: The museum plans to change its logo next year. Explain one benefit of having used a master slide.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: One benefit with expansion, e.g. the logo is changed once on the slide master (1) so every slide updates automatically / it is quicker than editing each slide (1); OR every slide keeps a consistent look (1) so the presentation follows the house style and looks professional (1).
Check / do not accept: Accept any correct master benefit with expansion. Benefit without expansion: 1 mark.

questions.label: S2
questions.question_text: State one reason why the text on a slide should be written as short bullet points.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Short bullet points are quick to read at a glance; they show only the key points; a larger font can be used so the text is easier to read on the screen.

questions.label: S3
questions.question_text: A Push effect is used when slide 1 changes to slide 2. State whether this is an animation or a transition, and give a reason.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Transition, because it is applied when moving from one slide to the next / to the whole slide, not to an object on a slide.
Check / do not accept: Transition and a correct reason both needed for the mark.

questions.label: S4
questions.question_text: Slide 1 moves to slide 2 automatically after 3 seconds. Describe one benefit of this for the kiosk presentation, and explain why the time must not be too short.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: The kiosk moves from the welcome slide to the Menu without a presenter or a visitor having to click (1). Visitors need enough time to read the slide before it changes (1).

questions.label: S5
questions.question_text: Every content slide has a Home action button. Explain why this button is needed when a presentation is run in kiosk mode.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: There is no presenter or keyboard, and clicking the slide does not move the show on (1) so the Home button lets visitors go back to the Menu and choose another section / without it they would be stuck on the slide (1).
Check / do not accept: Accept: visitors control which slide they see (1).

questions.label: S6
questions.question_text: A museum guide is giving a talk to a visiting school group. State which print layout should be used for each purpose: (i) a script for the guide (ii) a copy for each pupil with space to write notes (iii) one slide to display on the museum noticeboard.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: (i) Notes pages (1). (ii) Handouts (1). (iii) Full page slide (1).

questions.label: S7
questions.question_text: The guide uses Presenter View during the talk. Describe two things Presenter View shows the guide that the audience cannot see.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Any two: the speaker notes (1); a preview of the next slide (1); a timer or clock to keep track of time (1).
